newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves $200 mln ADR issue of BPL Cellular.
newsitem.headline: India approves $200 mln ADR issue of BPL Cellular.

text.p: The Indian government on Thursday said it had approved plans of BPL Cellular Holdings Ltd to raise $200 million through issue of American Depository Receipts (ADRs).
The plans were approved by the Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB), the statement said.
The issue will have a greenshoe option upto 15 percent and the shares will be listed on NASDAQ, it added.
BPL Cellular is the telephone infrastructure development company of India's BPL group and is engaged in development of wireless telecommunications in several states.
FIPB said the issue was approved on condition that the post-issue foreign direct investment in the firm shall not exceed 48 percent.
